title: [review] lichend.rs: Unchecked read_exact result discards entropy failu
description: The result of std::io::Read::read_exact is discarded with `let _`. If /dev/urandom read fails (e.g., EINTR, early EOF on exotic systems), the seed buffer `b` may contain zeroes or partial entropy. The code then creates and persists a weak cryptographic seed, permanently compromising identity keys.
close_reason: Fixed: read_exact result is now properly checked with if-let-Err pattern; process exits with error if entropy read fails, preventing weak seed creation
